lines.en: I push my cart along
The wheels grind the dirt road

lines.zh: 我从一个村子走到下一个
lines.en: I go from one village to the next
I circle the cart once
I tug the ropes on the cart
I walk in my own wheel ruts
I stop the cart in the shade
I sort the goods as I go
I work my way along the mountain road
I glance back at the cart
I push the cart over a small bridge
I stop to feed the pack animal
I push the cart around a mud hole
I pull the cart to the roadside
I check the axle as I walk
I follow the ruts a while
I sit against the cart
I count today's takings
I shift the bomb sacks
I wipe the crates with a cloth
I bite my nail and reckon the numbers

lines.zh: 我抬眼看路上有没有人
lines.en: I look up the road for travellers
I fold the pelts
I heft a bag of parts
I pat the cart's boards
I am often alone out here
I pour myself some water
I count the hooks on the cart
I look up, a customer
What will you be buying
I lift the cart's flap a little
You smell of coins
I trade in nothing else here

lines.zh: 我的货都是从村里来的
lines.en: My goods come from the village
Stand here, out of the road
Have a look at these pelts
Everything here is honest goods
Mushrooms would be even better
I hurry to cover my head
I shrink behind the cart
I check the goods
I steady myself on the cart

lines.zh: 货车里的炸弹袋，别乱翻。
lines.en: Don't rummage in my cart's bomb sacks.
I hurry to cover the goods
I can still push the cart
Do not hit my cart
Even my voice is shaking
Mushrooms? Let me see
Goods in hand make for good talk
I will take this one
I will give two for your one
Add a little more to make weight
I weighed it, it is short
Just set it on the cart board
I know this kind of mushroom
Do not palm off the rotten ones
Done, take your pick
You bumped my cart
I catch the crates at once
A bag of parts falls off
Do not lean on my cart
The cart boards rock
I gather the goods back up
This cart is all I own
You could not afford the damage
I pull the cart in a little
Careful now, do not shove
I have to watch my cart
I handle the road alone
There are a few girls in the village
But this cart travels too much
I spend most of the year on the road
I will think of that later
Let me sell this load first
Nobody wants to live on a cart
I smile and say nothing

lines.zh: 你把我说得不好意思了
lines.en: Now you have made me shy
I stoop and take up the goods
I brush the dirt off it
I set it back on the cart
This could fetch a few coins
I weigh it, not bad
I sort it into that pile
This one I keep
This is scrap, not stock
I hang it on the cart's side
I throw a cloth over it
Someone is on the road
I lower the flap
Have you come to buy
Let me see what you carry
Travellers are rare on this road
I spread the goods a little

lines.zh: 你要什么，我给你报个价
lines.en: Tell me what you want and I will price it
Do not circle my cart
I turn the cart crosswise
This deal can be made
Take your hand off the goods
I wait for you to speak
I watch you and the goods at once
I have seen that thing before
I put the best goods in the chest
You have been picking a long while
I do not like hands in my cart
I grip the cart handle
That price is already fair
Hesitate longer and it will be gone
I glance both ways along the road
I wait for you to pay
I set the scale on the cart board
I will remember this deal
I snatch up a hook from the cart
I swing the carrying pole across
I clutch my crate and back away.
I shove you off and guard the cart
I fling a handful of parts
I duck behind the cart boards

lines.zh: 我的钩子挂到你的袖子
lines.en: My hook catches your sleeve
I retreat while blocking
I lift a bomb sack and shake it
I dare not truly fight, only block
Wheels sound from up the road
I stop the cart at the crossing
I lift the flap and look out
The load rides high on the cart
I pull the reins
I draw the cart up by a tree
A cart joins the road

lines.zh: 我拍了拍车板让货归位
lines.en: I pat the boards and the goods settle
My shadow travels with the cart
I come around the back of the cart
Fire scorches the cart's canvas

lines.zh: 我摔下车板，东西散了一地
lines.en: I fall off the cart and my goods scatter
Water soaks my stock
The blast throws me under the cart
An arrow sticks in the cart board
Magic knocks over my scale

lines.zh: 路上一整天没吃上东西
lines.en: A whole day on the road without food

lines.zh: 雷击把车把烧黑了一截
lines.en: The strike blackens part of the handle
I fall still thinking of my goods
